semanticHashPolicy.importContractProjection: all top-level import behavior fields except semanticHashPolicy
semanticHashPolicy.compatibilityBoundary: V3 accepts only its current semantic contract. Existing V1/V2 COMPLETE runs must replay or roll back through their creating profile.

bagContainerWitness.catalogDecision: IGNORE/NOT_OBJECT_DOMAIN_INPUT with zero projection outputs; it is a completeness witness, not an item source key
bagContainerWitness.cardinality: exactly one per imported player, including an empty bag
bagContainerWitness.ownerBinding: owner_locator_sha256 equals canonical_players.source_identifier for source_system LEGACY_JSON and resolves the canonical player through that persisted unique pair
bagContainerWitness.payloadBinding: source_locator_sha256 and payload_fingerprint are copied without reinterpretation

completenessProjection.completeRule: projected_stack_count equals expected_source_key_count and quarantine/ignore counts are zero
completenessProjection.postImportMutationProof: bind exact typed stack and ledger child sets plus the current per-player ledger head as the import-commit baseline in the same transaction
completenessProjection.readinessContinuationRule: readiness verifies exact typed baseline children, every live sequence from 1 through current head, and baseline stack quantity plus all post-baseline deltas equals the exact current stack set; valid later mutations and newly created stacks remain eligible
completenessProjection.orderingBoundary: pre-490 ledger IDs receive deterministic dense baseline ordinals without any historical-time claim; only inserts after the captured baseline head use the atomic monotonic sequence
completenessProjection.excludedActualReadState: frozen PET-EQUIPMENT validation is not represented by this projection and remains a consumer actual-read state responsibility

transactionBoundary: one outer transaction inserts targets, target receipts, one completeness projection per BAG_CONTAINER witness, and only then marks the run COMPLETE
replay: same v3 profile, contract, witness, counts and current state fingerprints returns the prior run with zero writes; any drift fails closed
rollback: delete ledger-baseline children, stack-baseline children, and projection first; prove imported ledger mappings form the locked exact tail and that no post-import ledger exists; delete mappings and ledger rows in reverse order while atomically rewinding the head; then delete other targets and the import run. Unsafe or partial rollback fails closed
